svg.title: Layered botanical engraving - Whiskey Gin Beer Wine Oak - larger motifs v5 - engraving paths only
svg.desc: One SVG unit equals one inch. Stepped top: short arm 23 3/8 in, bend 20 in, long arm 49 1/4 in; all boards 8 1/2 in wide. Gray strokes encode on-line cuts. Coordinates match the measured proof; empty artboard space is not a registration guide. Cutter diameter and depth are not specified. Confirm dimensions and placement on-tool and test on scrap before cutting.
